name: FAN EXPO Portland
blurb: FAN EXPO HQ's Pacific Northwest show at the Oregon Convention Center, covering comics, anime, sci-fi and horror.

editions.evidence: Page JSON-LD: Event "FAN EXPO Portland" (title 'FAN EXPO Portland: 3 days of fun, workshops and stars!'); page text 'JANUARY 29 - 31, 2027 OREGON CONVENTION CENTER'.

notes: Multi-city FAN EXPO HQ brand. Despite being only ~4 months out, both the celebrities and comic-creators guest pages still show only a 'PAST FAN FAVE GUESTS INCLUDED' section (Elijah Wood, Sean Astin, Mark Brooks, Michael Golden, etc.) with 'sign up for updates' copy, not a 2027 lineup, so guests is 'none-yet' (compare fan-expo-new-orleans, a similarly-close show that does have a real 2027 announcement). The site's own 'See all Gaming Guests' link is mis-pointed to fanexpohq.com/fanexposanfrancisco/gaming/ (a different city), so that category was not used. Cover falls back to the 'FAN EXPO Portland' wordmark logo (no Portland-specific key art found).
